main_text.p: ἀνδρὸς συμμαχίαν. Et mox subjicit consilii hujus rationem. Βυζάντιοι γάρ, ait, μηδένα τῶν ἐν τοῖς ὑπερόχοις [?] ἐξ ἐπιτροπῆς ἐξ ἀνδρῶν ἐπιχειρεῖν τὴν συμμαχίαν, ὅτι εἰ ἕκλογὴν συνδυάζειν, ἀλλὰ ἀναλαμβάνειν σφὰς αὐτὰς ὀρθοῖς τῆς συνῳκήσεως· ἀλλ' ἀκέραιοι Δημοτικοὶ ὄντες κεχαλλίνειν τὰς ἐξ ἐκ τῶν ἐλπίδας. Strabonis verba, ἡ πεῖσ ἢ δημοκρατικώτερον, quae populi potestatem apud Rhodios negare videntur, sic interpretor, plebi imae potestatem regendae reipublicae non fuisse permissam, quae civilium ac publicarum rerum non minus fere imperita est quàm sutores aut piscatores pictúrae aut statuariae. Hanc verò plebem imam denotari ibi, satis arguunt voces illo loco ab autore usurpatae, οὐδὲς πέρ- οντες, τῶν ἀσυνήτων ταλλήλων [?], quibus τὰς ἀμπέρας autor opponit. Exiftimoque, apud Rhodios in civitate copiosa & locuplete eos, qui censum habebant, & honestiorum ordinum erant, populum constituisse, qui rempublicam curaret: capite censos, & proletarios ac similes ad curandam rempublicam non esse admissos: & tamen hos perbenigne esse

page.notes: Greek passages are only partly legible at this scan resolution; the Greek words are transcribed as far as they can be read, and the uncertain ones are marked [?]. The italic Greek on the line beginning "Strabonis verba" and the Greek phrases on the lines before "quibus" are the least certain. The page is a continuation: the first line is a fragment carried over from the previous page. The word "perbenigne" at the end of the page continues on the next page, with "esse" as catchword.
